comfy.note: 本地 ComfyUI 流程（scripts/comfy_batch.py）：Qwen3-TTS 克隆配音 → MiniMax H3 Reference to Video（<Audio 1> fully_copy 对口型）→ 原配音合回。2026-11-12 实测 10 秒段 672×1216 4 步约 8 分钟。
comfy.prompt_template:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the {who} in <Picture 1>: {look}.
<Audio 1> is the complete spoken {lang} vocal track of <Subject 1> (S1), {voice}.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is a single continuous {framing} talking-head shot of <Subject 1> {purpose}, with lip movements precisely synchronized to <Audio 1>, which is reused as the complete final audio track.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - face, hairstyle, outfit, framing and lighting stay identical to <Picture 1>.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - <Audio 1> is reused 1:1 as the target video's complete final audio track, and every syllable drives the matching mouth shape of <Subject 1>.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] {shot_desc} <Subject 1> (S1) speaks {lang} with lips, jaw and tongue clearly lip-synced to every syllable of <Audio 1>: <d>[{lang_tag}] {line}</d> {act}. {camera} During any silent pause in <Audio 1> her lips rest gently closed. After the last word {pron} closes {poss} lips into a soft smile and holds eye contact until the final frame. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.

overall_soundscape: Only <Audio 1> is heard, with quiet indoor room tone underneath; no added sound effects.

non_diegetic_music: None.

tank.voice_ref_text: 大家好呀，今天跟你聊一个特别实用的小技巧：只要一张照片加一句话，就能做出一条数字人口播视频，而且整个过程全部在本地完成。
tank.look: long black hair with loose strands framing her face, pink lips, a small mole on her chest, a white ribbed tank top, close selfie framing under warm natural indoor light against a plain dark ceiling
tank.voice: a clear, lively young female voice
tank.shot_desc: A vertical handheld selfie close-up of <Subject 1>, framed from the top of her head to her chest exactly as in <Picture 1>, warm sunlight across her face, plain dark ceiling behind her. She looks straight into the lens with warm eye contact and a relaxed, friendly smile.
tank.camera: The phone camera has only a very slight natural handheld sway, no zoom, no cuts.
tank.look_person: long black hair with loose strands framing her face, pink lips, a small mole on her chest, a white ribbed tank top
